title: Enterprise Connectivity: tax undiscounted transfer subtotal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this tax undiscounted transfer subtotal rule to separate statutory tax.

## Basis: undiscounted subtotal
For separate statutory tax, subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal.

## Basis Q&A
| Separate statutory tax basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Separate statutory tax: Subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price | this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. |

## Hypothetical transfer subtotal
For a hypothetical separate statutory tax, take monthly volume of 47 GB, included transfer of 20 GB and unit price USD 0.13. The excess is 27 GB, producing an undiscounted subtotal of USD 3.51. A hypothetical volume of 18 GB instead produces zero after the volume floor.
